notes: Generated by tools/parse_laminex.py from the Laminex National Availability Guide (2025-09): Formica Decorated MDF and Decorated Particleboard trade tables. Edging records carry only what the tables print (code, thickness, roll): width and material are not printed there, and the suggested (not exact match) edgings of some tables print no thickness, so they are left out. Item codes are per sheet size. Stocking columns are not recorded. The guide does not say which Formica decors are woodgrains: `grained` is false throughout, so check the grain direction of woodgrain decors yourself. Do not edit by hand: rerun the tool.
